File.description: The File JSON Schema is structured to represent a File, capturing key information required for managing it.

CreatedDate.description: The date and time when the file was initially created. This follows the ISO 8601 pattern.

FileId.description: A unique numeric identifier for the file, useful for tracking and reference.

FileLocation.description: The URL or path where the file is stored, often pointing to a location in SharePoint, OneDrive, or Teams.

FileName.description: The destination full path where the file will be uploaded to in a SharePoint site or OneDrive (e.g., 'Documents/Reports/Q3_Milestones_Update.docx'). The last segment after '/' must match the actual file name in FileLocation.

LastModifiedDate.description: The date and time when the file was last modified. This follows the ISO 8601 pattern.

SharedWith.description: A list of users the file is shared with.

FileDestination.description: The destination of the file. This field is not in use for now.

DestinationType.description: The type of destination for the file, which can be 'onedrive', 'site', or 'channel'.

FileSharedLinks.description: A list of file shared link config, if any.

Actions.description: A list of possible actions a customer can execute on a document.

RequireSignIn.description: Indicates whether sign-in is required to access the shared file.

SendInvitation.description: Indicates whether to send an invitation email to users when the file is shared.

DestinationSiteName.description: The name of the destination site, only applicable when DestinationType is site.

MailNickNameOrEmail.description: User MailNickName or external full email address

Share.description: Information describing the sharing of a file.

Email.description: The MailNickNameOrEmail of the user the file is shared with.

PermissionLevel.description: The level of access the user has.

FileSharedLink.description: Information describing the file shared link.

SharedLinkId.description: The unique identifier of the shared link.

Type.description: The level of access the user has.

ExpirationDateTime.description: The date and time when the shared link will expire, if applicable.

RetainInheritedPermissions.description: Indicates whether the shared link retains inherited permissions from the parent item.

Scope.description: The scope of the shared link.

Action.description: An action that can be performed on the file. By now we support only docx, xlsx and pptx documents.

ActionId.description: A unique identifier for the action, useful for tracking and reference.

Operation.description: The type of operation (e.g., view, edit, comment, open).

Content.description: Additional content for the action (e.g., comment text).
